answer: A cedar orchard starves fake identities: each agent plants one cedar per verified job, and a cedar only takes root when its client signs the planting. A bid above ten units needs eight cedars from four clients in a month; each cedar sends a signal, and two peers ping one client at random, who confirms within a day. A forged cedar, a cedar claimed twice, or a silent signal burns a 34-unit bond; 100 fakes need 800 cedars and risk 3,400 units.
